units.producer_stage: Completed rendered return; noStop/Responsecomplete, Pro; no new continuation sent.
units.producer_review_status: The return reports an internal diffusion calculation checked against a small-wavevector eigenvalue calculation to better than 2e-8 across tested finite exchange rates. No external review or experiment is reported.
units.source_reported_scope: Source-grounded spatial kinetic model for post-growth mobility of a 3C-SiC silicon–carbon divacancy, coupling two published charge-dependent atomic pivots through ordinary charge exchange; predicts a mobility window near a charge-state crossover.
units.scope_limitations: Baseline numbers depend on common 1e13 s^-1 attempt frequency, equal +1/0 degeneracy, a one-half antisite-exit factor, omission of activation-entropy correction, and an incompletely calibrated charged free-energy/escape network. The reported 1 s^-1 charge-equilibration case reaches about 70% of the fast-exchange diffusivity; the source bounds omitted charge-state weight but a rare low-barrier state could add a factor of a few. Intermediate trapping values are model estimates, not measurements. The result is not measured transport, a positioned device, or advantage over annealing; equilibrium model has no directed pump. The proposed selective-purification application fails because silicon vacancies convert to carbon-antisite vacancies at the reported baseline rate. Spatial targeting/capture/switching interface remains unresolved; original code/data attachment bytes UNKNOWN.
